planets.name: K2-72 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-72 with a 7.76-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: K2-72 d was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around K2-72. Its orbit and size follow Dressing et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
